limitations: Synthetic workload and tariffs. This is a planning experiment, not an actual bill or a validated fuel-shock sensitivity. Rolling exports may include an already-started nominal interval and are experimental. No model retraining, external market download or LLM request occurs here.

hedge.note: Hypothetical 24-hour contract for difference on NSW1 wholesale prices. A fixed volume settles in each half-hour against the assumed strike. The retail tariff has a multiplier and floor, so some exposure remains. Stress cases have no assigned probabilities. Fees and margin are excluded.
